tool_schemas.name: search_research_areas
tool_schemas.description: Searches PapersWithCode research areas by area name and returns a paginated list of matching areas; pagination is controlled by page and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is empty or if page/items_per_page are not positive integers. Raises RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service.

tool_schemas.name: get_research_area
tool_schemas.description: Returns the research area record for the provided area_id, including its stored metadata. Raises NOT_FOUND if no research area exists for area_id and VALIDATION_ERROR if area_id is empty or malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed.

tool_schemas.name: list_research_area_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks associated with the given research area_id and returns a paginated result set controlled by page and items_per_page. Raises NOT_FOUND if the research area does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if area_id is empty or page/items_per_page are not positive integers. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quota limits are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks access.

tool_schemas.name: search_authors
tool_schemas.description: Searches paper authors by full_name and returns a paginated list of author matches; pagination uses page and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if full_name is empty or if page/items_per_page are not positive integers. Raises RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_paper_author
tool_schemas.description: Returns the author record for the provided author_id. Raises NOT_FOUND if no author exists for author_id and VALIDATION_ERROR if author_id is empty or malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed.

tool_schemas.name: list_papers_by_author_id
tool_schemas.description: Lists papers linked to the given author_id and returns a paginated list controlled by page and items_per_page. Raises NOT_FOUND if the author does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if author_id is empty or page/items_per_page are not positive integers. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quota limits are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks access.

tool_schemas.name: list_papers_by_author_name
tool_schemas.description: Lists papers for authors matching the provided author_name and returns a paginated list controlled by page and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if author_name is empty or if page/items_per_page are not positive integers. Raises NOT_FOUND when no matching author (and therefore no papers) can be resolved for the supplied name, plus RATE_LIMITED and UNAUTHORIZED as applicable.

tool_schemas.name: list_conferences
tool_schemas.description: Lists conferences and optionally filters by conference_name, returning a paginated list controlled by page and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page/items_per_page are not positive integers or if conference_name is provided but empty. Raises RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_conference
tool_schemas.description: Returns the conference record for the provided conference_id. Raises NOT_FOUND if no conference exists for conference_id and VALIDATION_ERROR if conference_id is empty or malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed.

tool_schemas.name: list_conference_proceedings
tool_schemas.description: Lists proceedings associated with the given conference_id and returns a paginated list controlled by page and items_per_page. Raises NOT_FOUND if the conference does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if conference_id is empty or page/items_per_page are not positive integers. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quota limits are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks access.

tool_schemas.name: get_conference_proceeding
tool_schemas.description: Returns the proceeding identified by conference_id and proceeding_id, including its stored metadata and links to related entities where available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either ID is missing or not a string, NOT_FOUND if the conference does not exist or the proceeding is not found under that conference, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if your credentials do not permit access. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_conference_papers
tool_schemas.description: Lists papers associated with the specified conference_id and proceeding_id and returns a paged collection using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are invalid, page/items_per_page are not integers, or page/items_per_page are less than 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the conference or proceeding cannot be resolved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: search_papers
tool_schemas.description: Searches our mirrored PapersWithCode paper index by title, abstract, and/or arxiv_id and returns a paged list of matching papers using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if all search fields are null/empty, if arxiv_id/title/abstract are not strings, or if page/items_per_page are less than 1. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_paper
tool_schemas.description: Returns the paper record for the given paper_id, including its core metadata and stored cross-links where available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_id is missing or not a string, and NOT_FOUND if no paper exists with that ID in our mirror. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_paper_repositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists repositories linked to the given paper_id and returns a paged collection using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_id is invalid or if page/items_per_page are not integers or less than 1, and NOT_FOUND if the paper_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_paper_datasets
tool_schemas.description: Lists datasets linked to the given paper_id and returns a paged collection using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_id is invalid or if page/items_per_page are not integers or less than 1, and NOT_FOUND if the paper_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_paper_methods
tool_schemas.description: Lists methods linked to the given paper_id and returns a paged collection using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_id is invalid or if page/items_per_page are not integers or less than 1, and NOT_FOUND if the paper_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_paper_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists results linked to the given paper_id and returns a paged collection using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_id is invalid or if page/items_per_page are not integers or less than 1, and NOT_FOUND if the paper_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_paper_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks linked to the given paper_id and returns a paged collection using page (1-based) and items_per_page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_id is invalid or if page/items_per_page are not integers or less than 1, and NOT_FOUND if the paper_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: read_paper_from_url
tool_schemas.description: Resolves paper_url to a canonical paper in our stored URL mappings and returns an explanation/readout based on cached parsed content and enrichments when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paper_url is missing, not a string, or not a valid URL, and NOT_FOUND if the URL cannot be mapped to a known paper or no readable cached content exists for that mapping. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

metadata.name: PapersWithCode Client
metadata.description: This backend mirrors key entities from PapersWithCode (research areas, tasks, authors, papers, conferences/proceedings) and their relationships, enabling search and detail retrieval. It also stores enrichments and cross-links (paper↔author, paper↔task, paper↔repo/dataset/method/result) to serve list
